children: Elevance Health reaffirmed full-year 2026 shareholders' earnings guidance of at least $20.10 per diluted share, including about $6.90 of net unfavorable items.
Reaffirms GAAP shareholders' earnings guidance of at least $20.10 per diluted share for 2026, inclusive of ~ $6.90 per share net unfavorable items.
Excluding those items, expects adjusted shareholders' earnings of at least $27.00 per diluted share for full-year 2026.
Confirms 2026 benefit expense ratio guidance at 90.2% ±50 basis points, reiterating expense expectations for the year.
Guidance excludes any adjustment items beyond those reported in the company's Q2 2026 earnings release.
